title: Fetch native lane tips through an advertised ref
body: A fresh NTFS clone rejected git fetch /home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/vxtrain8 389b6645 with 'couldn't find remote ref 389b6645'. Fetching the advertised lane-vxtrain8 branch from the same worktree succeeded and produced the identical detached tip. Make the native-checkout recipe fetch the source branch ref (or otherwise advertise the tip) so the documented SHA-based command works on fresh clones.
